message: So, picture this: I’m all cozy at home, binge-watching my favorite show, when suddenly—bam! The lights go out. I fumble around for my flashlight, only to realize it’s sitting in the garage (classic Maria move). After a few minutes of stumbling around in the dark, I finally found a power bank to keep my phone alive for some emergency TikTok scrolling. 😅 Lesson learned: always have a flashlight handy and maybe a little backup plan for those unexpected moments. What’s your go-to trick for when the power goes out?
